description: This Java source file defines the class KeyboardAddOnBrowserFragment, which extends AbstractAddOnsBrowserFragment to provide a user interface component for browsing and applying keyboard add-ons within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes methods for retrieving add-on factories, search keywords, and applying selected add-ons to a demo keyboard view.

classes.name: KeyboardAddOnBrowserFragment
classes.description: A fragment class for browsing and applying keyboard add-ons in the AnySoftKeyboard app.

methods.name: KeyboardAddOnBrowserFragment
methods.description: Constructor initializing the fragment with specific parameters for UI behavior and item touch helper directions.

methods.name: getAddOnFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory responsible for providing keyboard add-ons, obtained from the application context.

methods.name: getMarketSearchKeyword
methods.description: Provides the search keyword 'language' for market searches related to keyboard add-ons.

methods.name: getMarketSearchTitle
methods.description: Returns the resource ID for the title string used in market search UI.

methods.name: applyAddOnToDemoKeyboardView
methods.description: Applies a selected keyboard add-on to the demo keyboard view by creating and loading the keyboard.
